name: Securities Financing
definition: Process of lending or borrowing cash or securities against securities or cash collateral. It aims at optimising liquidity, support a trading strategy, or increase settlement efficiency.

ReturnLegInstruction.name: Return Leg Instruction
ReturnLegInstruction.definition: Specifies whether, for a securities lending/borrowing settlement transaction, the lender will instruct the return leg as agreed with the borrower.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Specifies the type of securities financing transaction, that is, repurchase agreement, reverse repurchase agreement, securities lending or securities borrowing.

TerminationDateTime.name: Termination Date Time
TerminationDateTime.definition: Closing date/time or maturity date/time of the repo transaction.

RateChangeDateTime.name: Rate Change Date Time
RateChangeDateTime.definition: Date/Time at which rate change has taken place.

RevaluationIndicator.name: Revaluation Indicator
RevaluationIndicator.definition: Specifies whether the collateral position should be subject to automatic revaluation by the account servicer.

InterestPayment.name: Interest Payment
InterestPayment.definition: Specifies whether the interest is to be paid to the collateral taker. If set to no, the interest is paid to the collateral giver.

VariableRateSupport.name: Variable Rate Support
VariableRateSupport.definition: Index or support rate used together with the spread to calculate the repurchase rate.

RepurchaseRate.name: Repurchase Rate
RepurchaseRate.definition: Rate to be used to recalculate the repurchase amount.

StockLoanMargin.name: Stock Loan Margin
StockLoanMargin.definition: Percentage mark-up on a loan consideration used to reflect the lender's risk.

TransactionCallDelay.name: Transaction Call Delay
TransactionCallDelay.definition: Minimum number of days' notice a counterparty needs for terminating the transaction.

TotalNumberOfCollateralInstructions.name: Total Number Of Collateral Instructions
TotalNumberOfCollateralInstructions.definition: Indicates the total Number of collateral instructions involved in the transaction.

DealAmount.name: Deal Amount
DealAmount.definition: Deal amount of the second leg.

ForfeitRepurchaseAmount.name: Forfeit Repurchase Amount
ForfeitRepurchaseAmount.definition: Fixed amount which has to be paid (instead of interest) in the case of a recall.

PremiumAmount.name: Premium Amount
PremiumAmount.definition: Difference between the cash amount of the first leg and the cash amount of the |second leg of the repurchase agreement.

TerminationAmountPerPieceOfCollateral.name: Termination Amount Per Piece Of Collateral
TerminationAmountPerPieceOfCollateral.definition: Amount of money to be settled per piece of collateral to terminate the transaction.

TerminationTransactionAmount.name: Termination Transaction Amount
TerminationTransactionAmount.definition: Total amount of money to be settled to terminate the transaction.

MaturityDateModification.name: Maturity Date Modification
MaturityDateModification.definition: Specifies whether the maturity date of the securities financing transaction may be modified.

EarliestCallBackDate.name: Earliest Call Back Date
EarliestCallBackDate.definition: Earliest date/time at which the call back can take place.

OpeningSettlementDate.name: Opening Settlement Date
OpeningSettlementDate.definition: Date and time at which the securities are to be delivered or received.

RepurchaseType.name: Repurchase Type
RepurchaseType.definition: Specifies the type of repurchase transaction.

SpreadTransaction.name: Spread Transaction
SpreadTransaction.definition: Specifies that there will be one price and one transaction when two contracts are carried out simultaneously, one to buy and the other one to sell with two different expiration dates.

OpeningSettlementAmount.name: Opening Settlement Amount
OpeningSettlementAmount.definition: Total amount of money to be paid or received in exchange for the securities at the opening of a securities financing transaction.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique identification of the repurchase agreement.

TerminationOption.name: Termination Option
TerminationOption.definition: Indicates the termination option for a repurchase agreement.

Interest.name: Interest
Interest.definition: Interest to be paid on the transaction amount.

RepurchaseSpread.name: Repurchase Spread
RepurchaseSpread.definition: Repurchase spread expressed as a rate; margin over or under an index that determines the repurchase rate.

EndPrice.name: End Price
EndPrice.definition: Negotiated fixed price of the security to buy it back.

FinancingAgreement.name: Financing Agreement
FinancingAgreement.definition: Provides the contractual details related to the agreement between parties.

ClosingLegExecution.name: Closing Leg Execution
ClosingLegExecution.definition: Repayment of the previously received cash by one party in exchange of the return of the security by the counterparty.

OpeningLegExecution.name: Opening Leg Execution
OpeningLegExecution.definition: Transfer of cash to a party against the legal transfer of securities. The cash receiver agrees to buy the same security from the counterparty at a fixed price at some later date.

RelatedIndicationOfInterest.name: Related Indication Of Interest
RelatedIndicationOfInterest.definition: Indication of interest process which is the source of a securities financing process.
